parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a parameter value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: How to ensure idempotence.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the account. The display name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address. The email prefix can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The email address can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: EmailVerified
parameters.description: Specifies whether the email address is verified as a trusted email address. This parameter is required if Email is specified. If no special business requirement exists, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnitIds
parameters.description: The list of organizational unit IDs to which the account belongs. An account can belong to multiple organizational units.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password. The password must meet the requirements of the password policy.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number. The value is a 6 to 15-digit number.

parameters.name: PhoneNumberVerified
parameters.description: Specifies whether the phone number is verified as a trusted phone number. This parameter is required if PhoneNumber is specified. If no special business requirement exists, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: PhoneRegion
parameters.description: The phone region code. The value is a 1 to 6-digit number and does not include a plus sign (+).

parameters.name: PrimaryOrganizationalUnitId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary organizational unit.

parameters.name: UserExternalId
parameters.description: The external ID of the account. This parameter is used to associate the account with an external system. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. If this parameter is not specified, the account ID is used by default.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. The username can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), at signs (@), and hyphens (-). The username can be up to 256 characters in length.
